subject: Accelerator stacking safeguard: cohort + trial credits coordination
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@launchpad.vc>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator credit stacking — cohort + trial credits?

Hi Connor,

Quick question from our ops team: many of our portfolio founders get a cohort grant from us and then sign up for Redwood trials. Can cohort credits and Redwood trial/onboarding credits be applied together (stacked) on the same account, or do they need to be used in sequence? The founders want predictable runway and we need to understand any safeguards so we can coordinate communications.

Also: if stacking is allowed, does it affect eligibility to convert to Reserved Capacity later? Any visibility on expiration windows or double-dipping protections would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Programs Lead, LaunchPad Ventures
ops@launchpad.vc

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@launchpad.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit stacking — cohort + trial credits?

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear question. Short answer: we can support stacking in most cases, but we recommend a small set of safeguards so it doesn't create unintended accounting or conversion advantages.

Proposal (high level):
- Allow cohort grant + Redwood trial credits on the same account.
- Apply cohort credits as a separate "sponsorship bucket" that consumes before paid usage but after any promotional trial credits. This prevents promos from being double-applied to the same usage meter.
- Expiration: cohort grant valid for 90 days from activation by default; trial credits expire after 60 days. We can change buckets per your program rules.
- Reserved conversion: when a customer converts to Reserved Capacity, any unused cohort credits can be (a) forfeited, (b) applied as a one-time invoice credit, or (c) rolled into a discounted conversion credit — we need to pick one.

I've attached a simple mapping spreadsheet that shows how usage flows between buckets and a configurable cap (we suggest starting with a 50% monthly usage cap applied to combined promo discounts to avoid extended double-dipping on sustained heavy usage).

If that sounds reasonable, I'll loop in Ben (pricing) and Laura (billing/tax) to confirm the legal/ops constraints and get a short SOW outlined.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

(attachment: cohort_credit_map.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit stacking — cohort + trial credits?

Connor — thanks for the draft. A few operational notes from pricing/finance:

- We can support the bucketed approach. Operational guardrails we should include in the SOW:
  * A per-account monthly discount cap (we typically start at 50% of token cost covered by combined promos).
  * An activation event for cohort credits (founder confirms onboarding email) to avoid dormant accounts holding credits.
  * Clear PO/invoice path for reserved conversion so we don't accidentally double-count credits against committed usage.

- Tax/recognition: Laura, please confirm whether rolling credits to an invoice credit (option b) triggers any revenue recognition issues for LaunchPad. If so, option c (conversion discount) might be preferable but requires a contract addendum.

I've drafted a short SOW outline that defines credit buckets, expiration windows, and the conversion carve-outs. Attaching SOW outline for your review.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Strategy — Redwood Inference
(attachment: SOW-accelerator-stacking-outline.pdf)

From: Maya Singh <maya@launchpad.vc>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit stacking — cohort + trial credits?

Thanks Connor and Ben — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from LaunchPad's procurement side:

- We'd prefer stacking to be available for the first 90 days (matching our cohort timeline). Can trial credits be set to 90 days for LaunchPad participants instead of the 60-day default?
- Founders sometimes don't use the full stipend in the window; can unused cohort credits roll forward to a 30-day grace period rather than immediate forfeiture?
- For conversion: our portfolio often moves to Reserved Capacity after month 3. We'd like a conversion path where unused cohort credits convert into a one-time invoice credit (option b) — that helps founders manage cashflow. Can Redwood accommodate that, and will that require a legal addendum?

Procurement also flagged that we'll need a short PO template and a vendor addendum for the 90-day exception. Attached is our internal PO requirements doc — it lists the fields Legal will require.

If you can send a short SOW + PO template and an estimated fiscal impact (how much discount/credit exposure this creates at typical cohort sizes), we can get this through Ops and Legal this week.

Best,
—Maya
(attachment: LaunchPad_PO_req.pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@launchpad.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit stacking — cohort + trial credits?

Maya — appreciate the clear asks. Confirming the agreed commercial path so we can move to PO and SOW: 

1) Stacking: LaunchPad cohort grants can be stacked with Redwood trial credits for LaunchPad participants.
2) Expiration windows: we will set both trial and cohort credits to a 90-day window for this program.
3) Roll-forward: unused cohort credits get a 30-day grace period.
4) Conversion: unused cohort credits may be applied as a one-time invoice credit at Reserved Capacity conversion (option b). This will require a short addendum on the conversion order; Legal ops will handle the language.
5) Safeguard: per-account monthly promo cap set to 50% of token spend coverage — protects against indefinite heavy usage subsidization.

Attachments: I uploaded the SOW outline and the PO template with the required fields filled for LaunchPad. Also included a simple exposure estimate assuming 40 founders, average 150k tokens/month over 3 months.

Next steps:
- LaunchPad: confirm PO fields and send PO by EOD Friday to ops@redwood.ai.
- Redwood: Ben/Laura/Marissa will finalize addendum language and return a countersigned SOW within 48 hours of PO receipt.

Deal id: LPV-2027-0453 — Connor will own handoff to CS for onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to getting founders onboarded.
